Landing.title: Your life, on your own calendar.
Landing.subtitle: Budgets on Jalali months, money in Toman, weeks that start on Saturday. Finance, tasks, habits and calendar — in one place.
Landing.weekNote: Weeks here start on Saturday — like your own calendar.
Landing.modulesSubtitle: Each module does its own job; all of them run on one shared core. The web is only the first client.
Landing.moduleFinanceDesc: Income and expenses in Toman, budgets per Jalali month.
Landing.moduleCalendarDesc: Events, recurrence and holidays — Jalali and Gregorian.
Landing.moduleReportsDesc: A monthly wrap-up: spending, budgets, tasks done.
Landing.moduleNotificationsDesc: Know the moment spending passes a budget cap.
Landing.proofJalali: The Jalali month is a budget boundary, not just a date format.
Landing.proofToman: Amounts in Toman — no decimals, no rounding errors.
Landing.proofSaturday: Weekly stats run Saturday through Friday.
Landing.footerApi: Everything through one API — more clients on the way.

Onboarding.welcomeBody: Let's take a quick look at where to get started.
Onboarding.navBody: Switch between Finance, Tasks, Habits, Calendar, Notifications, and Reports from here.
Onboarding.helpBody: Every page has a help button explaining how that part works.
Onboarding.logoutBody: Use this button any time you want to sign out.

finance.title: Finance dashboard help
items: Shows your financial summary: total balance, wallet balances, spending by category, and this month's budgets.
Use the sidebar to manage wallets, categories, or record a transaction.
Numbers are calculated for the current Jalali month.

wallets.title: Wallets help
items: Each wallet is an account or money source (cash, bank, etc.).
A wallet's balance is derived from its recorded transactions, not a fixed number.
Use the button at the top of the page to add a new wallet.

categories.title: Categories help
items: Categories group transactions as income or expense.
Every transaction must have exactly one category.
Budgets are defined per expense category.

transactions.title: Transactions help
items: Record every deposit or expense here and assign its wallet and category.
Filter the list by wallet or category.
Recording an expense over a budget's limit sends you a notification.

budgets.title: Budgets help
items: Set a monthly limit for each expense category.
Spending against that limit is calculated and shown automatically.
Going over a budget's limit creates a notification for you.

tasks.title: Tasks help
items: Manage your work by status (to do, in progress, done) and priority.
Assign each task to a project and multiple labels.
Subtasks and deadlines are managed from within each task.

projects.title: Projects help
items: Projects group related tasks together.
Deleting a project doesn't delete its tasks — they just become projectless.

labels.title: Labels help
items: Labels are a quick way to tag tasks independent of their project.
A task can have multiple labels.

calendar.title: Calendar help
items: See your events, task deadlines, and public holidays in one place.
Switch between the "Agenda" (daily list) and "Week" (weekly grid) views.
Click an event to edit or delete it; tasks and holidays are read-only here.

notifications.title: Notifications help
items: Notifications other modules create (like going over a budget) appear here.
Clicking an unread notification marks it as read.
You can mark all of them as read at once.

reports.title: Reports help
items: Shows a combined monthly summary of your finances and tasks.
For full detail on either, visit the Finance dashboard or the Tasks page.

habits.title: Habits help
items: Define daily or weekly habits and check them off each day you complete them.
Your streak is calculated automatically from your check-in history.
Open a habit's monthly calendar to check off or undo past days too.

settings.title: Settings
items: Set or clear your display name — it is optional.
Choose your time zone and calendar type (Jalali or Gregorian).
See devices signed in to your account and sign any of them out remotely.
The privacy policy is linked from this page.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Maal-e To is a life-management app covering finance, tasks, habits, and calendar. This page states plainly what is stored, why, and what control you have over it.
Privacy.collectIdentifier: Your phone number or email address — the only way to sign in. There are no passwords.
Privacy.collectName: A display name, if you provide one. It is optional and you can remove it at any time.
Privacy.collectContent: The content you enter yourself: transactions, wallets, budgets, tasks, habits, events, and notes.
Privacy.collectDevice: For each sign-in, a session record with the time, IP address, and browser/device user agent — so you can see active devices and sign them out remotely.
Privacy.noCollectAnalytics: No third-party analytics. No advertising trackers, no advertising cookies.
Privacy.noCollectPermissions: The Android app requests no permission other than internet access — no contacts, no location, no camera, no storage.
Privacy.noCollectSale: Your data is never sold or shared with anyone.
Privacy.useBody: Only to run the app itself: authenticating you, showing you your own data, and computing things like a wallet balance or a habit streak. There is no other use.
Privacy.storageBody: Data is stored on our own server in a PostgreSQL database. One-time codes and refresh tokens are never stored in raw form — only their hashes. Access tokens are short-lived, and you can revoke any session immediately.
Privacy.rightsAccess: You can view and edit all of your data inside the app.
Privacy.rightsDevices: You can sign out any active device from Settings.
Privacy.rightsDelete: To delete your account and all its data, contact us at the address below.
